subject: E-Commerce
title: Cryptocurrency in Cross-Border Trade
description: A quick win: understand Cryptocurrency in Cross-Border Trade.

hook.text: Stablecoins processed $10 trillion in payments in 2023. Some cross-border merchants now accept USDT and USDC.

buildup.text: Traditional wire transfers take 3-5 days and cost $25-50. Stablecoin transfers settle in minutes for pennies.

discovery.text: In countries with currency controls like Nigeria and Argentina, stablecoins enable commerce that banks block.

twist.text: Regulators worldwide are cracking down on stablecoin payments. Legal uncertainty keeps most merchants away.

climax.text: Crypto solves real problems in cross-border payments but faces massive regulatory and adoption barriers.

punchline.text: The goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: Why are stablecoins appealing for cross-border commerce?
options: Near-instant settlement and minimal fees compared to wire transfers
